description: The pie chart on the left of Figure 6 illustrates the distribution of data sources in the combined training set. It consists of 13 slices, with category labels and corresponding percentages positioned outside the chart and connected to their respective segments by thin gray lines, rather than using a separate legend or internal labels. The slices are not ordered by size and utilize a repeating color palette. Reading clockwise starting from the top right, the segments include NQ in blue (31.3%), SCIFACT in orange (0.1%), ENTFA in green (1.8%), FACTCC in red (2.6%), ANLI in purple (4.6%), and FEVER in light blue (16.1%). Continuing around the chart, the remaining categories are MULTIFC in orange (0.5%), MULTINLI in green (11.3%), PUBHEALTH in red (0.5%), SCITAIL in purple (1.2%), SNLI in orange (15.4%), VITAMINC in light blue (13.0%), and XSUMHUL in purple (1.6%). None of the slices are visually emphasized, exploded, or offset.
